hook: Present an abstract topic in polished spoken German, and hold your ground calmly when someone pushes back.
intro: The closing conversation of this module, in your own AI assistant with voice on: presenting an abstract topic (education, research, attention) in structured, formal spoken German, and defending it under questions. Copy the exercise in, say 'Los geht's', answer in full sentences; the score and corrections come at the end. The tutor listens for the markers of polished formal speech: an announced structure (zunächst – anschließend – abschließend), nominal phrases used with control (die Auswirkungen der Digitalisierung auf …), the formal connectors (sofern, zumal, insofern als, allerdings, hingegen), passive substitutes (ist zu bedenken, lässt sich feststellen), a participial or adverbial clause of each kind, and evaluative adjectives (nachvollziehbar, vertretbar). This is a talk and the discussion that follows it — at work, at university or at a public meeting — in rehearsal.
tips[0].title: Structure first, then density
tips[0].text: Announce the plan; then, inside each part, one nominal phrase, one formal connector, one substitute: 'Zunächst zur Ausgangslage: Die zunehmende Nutzung digitaler Medien ist zu beobachten, zumal …'
tips[0].check.why: sein + zu + infinitive is the passive substitute that gives each part its formal density: nicht zu übersehen.
tips[1].title: Defend with a concession and a condition
tips[1].text: Das ist ein berechtigter Einwand; allerdings … · Sofern man … berücksichtigt, … · Ich räume ein, dass …, halte aber … für vertretbar.
tips[1].check.why: To concede is einräumen: Ich räume ein, dass … and then you defend your point with allerdings or dennoch.
tips[1].visual.moves[0].label: Concede
tips[1].visual.moves[1].label: Condition
tips[1].visual.moves[2].label: Hold
tips[2].title: One participial clause, placed early
tips[2].text: Auf die Frage zurückkommend, … / Von den Zahlen ausgehend, … — one at the start of an answer sounds polished and costs nothing.
tips[2].check.why: The participial opener uses the Partizip I: von … ausgehend (proceeding from …).
remember[0]: Announce – nominal phrase – formal connector – substitute – concede – conclude.
remember[1]: sofern, zumal, insofern als, allerdings: one per answer.
exam: A structured talk followed by a discussion is the core of the C1 speaking exam — and of many meetings at work.
